This discomfort arises because our brains are wired to seek novelty and avoid monotony, as it is believed that such engagement was crucial for survival in evolutionary terms. Boredom can also lead to rumination and negative thoughts, which further exacerbate the discomfort. Thus, the aversion to boredom is deeply rooted in our psychological makeup, driving us to seek out activities and experiences that will alleviate this unpleasant state.
